description: Implementation of the Packager class handling package management, configuration, repository synchronization, plugin deactivation, and notifications within the WPEFramework plugin system.

classes.name: PackagerImplementation
classes.description: Class implementing package management functionalities including install, sync, configuration, and plugin deactivation within the plugin system.

methods.name: UpdateConfig
methods.description: Updates the package manager configuration based on current settings.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the package manager with provided service parameters.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback for package events.

methods.name: Install
methods.description: Initiates installation of a package by name, version, and architecture.

methods.name: DoWork
methods.description: Performs package installation or repository synchronization.

methods.name: BlockingInstallUntilCompletionNoLock
methods.description: Performs a blocking package install operation.

methods.name: GetMetadataFile
methods.description: Retrieves the metadata file path for a given app.

methods.name: GetCallsign
methods.description: Extracts the callsign from package metadata.

methods.name: GetInstallationPath
methods.description: Constructs the installation path for a given app.

methods.name: UpdateConfiguration
methods.description: Updates plugin configuration with callsign and install path.

methods.name: DeactivatePlugin
methods.description: Deactivates a plugin by callsign and updates configuration.

methods.name: NotifyStateChange
methods.description: Notifies registered observers of a package state change.

methods.name: NotifyRepoSynced
methods.description: Notifies observers of repository synchronization status.

methods.name: BlockingSetupLocalRepoNoLock
methods.description: Sets up local repository, optionally updating package lists.
